note: GAM-009 Stacks — a level PACK (not a daily). Every level is proven solvable by the BFS solver in public/js/stacks.js (scripts/test-stacks.mjs runs it on all levels). Legend: '#' brick, 'b' block, '@' player start, 'D' door, '.' empty. Difficulty curve: 1-5 teach one idea each, 6+ combine. Original name/levels/art.

levels.name: First steps
levels.hint: Walk to the door.

levels.name: Up one
levels.hint: Face a wall one tile high and climb it.

levels.name: Two steps
levels.hint: Climb a staircase one tile at a time.

levels.name: Grab
levels.hint: Pick up the block in front of you, then set it down.

levels.name: One block up
levels.hint: Carry the block to the wall, set it down as a step, then climb over.

levels.name: Carry across
levels.hint: Bring the block the long way to build your step at the wall.

levels.name: Two high
levels.hint: One block is not enough. Build a two-step staircase to clear the tall wall.

levels.name: Three steps
levels.hint: A taller wall needs a taller staircase — three blocks, three steps.

levels.name: Two walls
levels.hint: Two low walls, two blocks. Spend each one where it counts.

levels.name: Reach
levels.hint: The blocks are far from the wall. Ferry them over one at a time.

levels.name: Long haul
levels.hint: A tall wall and a long walk. Plan the staircase before you start.

levels.name: Over and down
levels.hint: Climb the wall; the door sits low on the far side.

levels.name: Higher still
levels.hint: A three-tile wall with the blocks spread out. Gather them at the wall.

levels.name: In two acts
levels.hint: Clear the first wall, then build again for the second.

levels.name: Staircase
levels.hint: Four tiles high. You will need every block and a full staircase.

levels.name: Ferry
levels.hint: The blocks sit past the wall's foot. Bring each one back into place.

levels.name: Step and over
levels.hint: A step up, then a wall to scale. Read the whole board first.

levels.name: The climb
levels.hint: The hardest yet: a four-tile wall and a long approach.

levels.name: Long approach
levels.hint: Three blocks by your feet, a tall wall far away. Carry them the distance.

levels.name: Two gates
levels.hint: Two low walls, two blocks. Spend each one where it counts.

levels.name: High and far
levels.hint: A four-tile wall with the blocks spread down the room.

levels.name: Two steps up
levels.hint: A wall, a gap, and a second wall. Read where each block has to land.

levels.name: The tower
levels.hint: Five tiles high. Four blocks, one long staircase, no room for waste.

levels.name: Switchback
levels.hint: Climb, cross, and climb again — a wall on each side of the room.

levels.name: The long wall
levels.hint: Four tiles high, three blocks, and a long walk. Build the whole staircase.

levels.name: Twin steps
levels.hint: Two walls, one block for each. Do not spend both in the same place.

levels.name: The great tower
levels.hint: Five tiles high. Four blocks, one perfect staircase, nothing to spare.

levels.name: Mind the gap
levels.hint: A pit you cannot climb out of. Set a block down as a bridge before you cross.

levels.name: Gauntlet
levels.hint: Three gates, three blocks. Clear them in a single run.

levels.name: The last door
levels.hint: Everything you have learned: a tall wall, spare blocks, and one way through.
